description: Medium-size reusable fixture bed for PLAN 16 QA — documents structure, not dynamic IDs

phases.check: Read-only prerequisite report (CLI profiles, identities, catalog)
phases.identity: 15 Entra users, 3 account SPs, 2 UMI SPs (looked up), 2 Entra groups (looked up), 2 account groups (nested)
phases.warehouses: 1 Pro SQL warehouse, 1 Serverless SQL warehouse
phases.uc: UC tables (trips, zones) for dashboards/Genie/DLT to reference
phases.compute: 3 instance pools, 2 cluster policies, 1 policy-family policy
phases.workspace: Per-user content (/Users/<email>/wsmig/), /Shared tree, git folder (metadata only)
phases.secrets: 1 Databricks-backed secret scope with 2 secrets and ACLs
phases.akv: 1 Azure Key Vault-backed secret scope (manual migration expected)
phases.sql: 1 SQL warehouse (pro), 2 legacy SQL queries, 2 alerts v2
phases.genie: 2 Genie spaces with UC table references and ACLs
phases.dashboards: 6 AI/BI dashboards: draft, published (2 credential modes), scheduled (with ACLs)
phases.jobs: 11 jobs: notebook/sql/python/dbt/run_job/pipeline tasks, scheduled, multi-task, job_clusters
phases.misc: 2 global init scripts, workspace conf (non-default values)
phases.dab: 2 DAB bundles: one under /Shared, one under user dir, each with job+pipeline+dashboard
phases.bigfiles: 1 file > 10 MB (streaming route), 1 notebook > export cap (manual expected)
phases.libraries: 1 cluster library on a TERMINATED cluster (fail→heal via retry+force_start)
phases.b3_policy_family: 1 cluster policy created from policy_family_id (PLAN 13 B3 case)
phases.orphaned_users: 2 of 15 users unassigned from workspace (deleted_in_source on import)
phases.acls: Cross-user/group/SP grants on all object types
phases.incremental: Run 2 seed: edits to existing objects, new user, group membership change

full_migrate: All 15 users content (2 orphaned diverted to /Users_Backup per PLAN 9)
3 account SPs, 2 Entra+2 account groups (assign, never recreate)
All compute, jobs (all task types), DLT, SQL, Genie, serving, misc
manual_step: AKV secret scope (AAD token not obtainable in notebooks)
Legacy SQL dashboards + alerts (create API deprecated)
skip_dab: DAB-deployed assets (marked skip in export, never imported)
expected_migration_outcome.acl_parity: All cross-user/group/SP grants remapped per identity_map.json

env_vars.WSMIG_CATALOG: UC catalog for fixture tables (default: workspace default catalog)
